# KB: <symptom or problem>

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Investigating / Resolved / Unverified |
| Date | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Related issue | <link> |
| Environment | <lab system, version, service> |

## Symptom and expected behavior
Describe what happened, impact, and what should have happened.

## Investigation
Record checks in order, commands or GUI paths, observed results, and relevant logs. Separate observations from assumptions.

## Root cause
State the confirmed cause and supporting evidence, or explicitly say it is unconfirmed.

## Resolution
Record the exact changes made and any prerequisites.

## Validation
Describe the tests performed, actual outcomes, and evidence links. Include a negative test where relevant.

## Recovery
Record reversal/recovery steps and remaining limitations.

## Lessons and follow-up
Document prevention, reusable learning, and open issue links.
